description: Return the rendered HTML of a target — the whole document, or just the subtree of the first element matching a CSS selector. This is the DOM the agent should read instead of a screenshot: it carries far more information and is exact.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the snapshot to (omit for the full document).

target_id.description: Target id from list_targets — the page / webview / Electron window to inspect.

name: dom_snapshot
title: DOM snapshot
